notes: A fresh named volume completed the first managed Codex turn without manual directory or login recovery.
Codex authentication was materialized by Limina from server configuration and the raw key was absent from the child environment.
The provider reported per-turn token usage; cost remained explicitly unavailable because no operator pricing was configured.
ChatGPT device login is implemented and tested as single-runtime-node instance state; a human browser completion was not part of this API-key trial.
This acceptance supports a trusted internal PoC, not a multi-tenant production claim.
